reviewedBoundaries.conclusion: createBookmark captures the Library epoch, uses its immutable session/objects, and reads the genuine frame inside session.perform under a cancellation-aware lease and original Library authorization. The primary current lifetime is never reactivated; the primary session forwards caller cancellation to its tracked child and drains on revocation. Final epoch/cancellation checks precede pending insertion.

The frame reader is obtained from the original object creator and validates the native capability, exact response scope, account and final authorization. frame.canWrite is a past observation. Eventual dispatch independently requires current lease, matching descriptor binding and current native member write permission, and then the original guarded ObjectCreator authority.

One initial makeBookmarkCreationFrameReader/frame call site exists. Pending state holds the plan, frame, binding and immutable creation intent before dispatch. retryCreation never fetches a replacement frame or constructs a new mutation ID; its adapter reconstructs and compares the original plan/frame fingerprint before calling the original creator/journal.

The typed override enters the same existing repository.create serial operation. The entire original mutationTail/withTaskCancellationHandler body is unchanged; there is no Bookmark queue or parallel journal. The original creator owns admitted-write settlement and its worker drain. Canceled or revoked preparation cannot publish pending/success; an uncertain admitted creation retains its pending request and original journal state.

The binding uses the original imported descriptor validator and original policy, checks actual eligible imported Type and native owner/key, visible synced string URL role, any.name and current definitions. The exact native frame account/Space/type/owner/property and sorted collection union must agree. It adds the URL once in its mapped namespace, preserves ordinary hierarchy fields, and introduces no schema provisioning, Note marker, body block, preview or second Name field.

The unchanged hierarchy readback first checks original object/type/title/parent/position/kind. Fresh Properties readback then requires original object/Type, all intended collection memberships, exact UTF8 URL and Name, visible validated URL role, current writable snapshot and unchanged binding/generation/run. A final current-authority check precedes UI delivery. The collections test is the existing inclusion contract, not a newly claimed rejection of all additional native memberships.

The caller validates the captured Library epoch before setting its confirmed object ID and after hierarchy refresh before opening. Existing confirmed-ID/snapshot reconciliation removes pending entries. Revoke advances the epoch and disables writes; stale work cannot publish into a replacement owner. Queued sheet submission uses the same never-reactivated lifetime and one consumed submission; no new owner is acquired for an old request.

Read the real public 6866 frame/creator signatures, @Sendable session/authorization closure shapes, typed wrapper and appended fixtures. Four Host XCTest methods exercise controlled decoded frame binding/intent/readback with positive controls; their tokens are explicitly not native signatures. The exact two previously reviewed hierarchy tests enter and drain the real existing mutation queue, reject foreign workspace before creation, cancel both held/queued operations, assert zero dispatch and require a fresh current action to succeed. No concrete API/actor issue found by source review; actual compilation remains necessary.
